title: Rebranding a family bakery chain
problem: Six bakeries looked like six different shops, and new customers did not know they were one chain.
constraints: Signage budget for two shops a year
Keep the founder's hand-drawn wheat mark

decisions.choice: Redraw the wheat mark and keep it
decisions.why: Regulars recognised the mark; it just did not reproduce small

outcomes.text: Shops repainted in the new system
The owners said customers now ask about the other shops

assets.alt: Stack of cake boxes in cream and rust with the redrawn wheat mark
Shopfront with the new rust awning and wheat mark sign
